<section>
<div class="container--medium">
<div class="heading-block">
<h2>FAQs</h2>
</div>
<div class="row-fluid">
<div class="span6">
<div class="text-block text--left">
<h4 class="text-block__heading">How do I get a quote?</h4>
<p class="text-block__text">Get a free quote in under 30 seconds for any parcel from your Sendle Dashboard. Simply sign-up for a free Sendle
            account and add in your pickup and delivery info, and the parcel size and weight.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="span6">
<div class="text-block text--left">
<h4 class="text-block__heading">Is Sendle an express service?</h4>
<p class="text-block__text">In general, same-city deliveries arrive overnight and deliveries to nearby cities within 2-3 days. Though very
            speedy, Sendle does not currently offer an express or guaranteed overnight delivery service.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row-fluid">
<div class="span6">
<div class="text-block text--left">
<h4 class="text-block__heading">Can Sendle pick up from me?</h4>
<p class="text-block__text">Yes! To arrange a pickup, all you need to do is book online and print and attach the label. Sendle picks up from
            over 90% of Australian addresses – check out the
            <a href="https://support.sendle.com/hc/en-au/articles/205204758-Locations-and-coverage">Locations &amp; Coverage guide</a> for the full list.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="span6">
<div class="text-block text--left">
<h4 class="text-block__heading">What can I send?</h4>
<p class="text-block__text">Sendle is designed to make delivering all things a breeze. There are some items that you can't book with Sendle,
            such as dangerous goods, and anything that is heavier than 25kg or bigger than 100 litres in volume.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="text--center">
<a class="button--secondary" href="https://support.sendle.com/hc/en-au">Common questions</a>
</div>
</div>
</section>
